title: Bangalore Water Supply and Sewerage Board v. A. Rajappa

content.caseIdentity: Bangalore Water Supply and Sewerage Board v. A. Rajappa, (1978) 2 SCC 213
content.facts: The Constitution Bench considered the meaning of industry under the Industrial Disputes Act.
questionsBeforeCourt: What functional test determines whether an undertaking is an industry?
content.ratioDecidendi: The triple test examines systematic activity, cooperation between employer and employee, and production or distribution of goods or services, subject to recognised exclusions.
content.holding: The Court adopted a broad functional interpretation.
content.relevance: Use for IDA s. 2(j) and coverage.

propositionVerification.note: Official Supreme Court judgment confirms and discusses Bangalore Water Supply and Sewerage Board v. A. Rajappa, (1978) 2 SCC 213 and its industry test.
